raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Preserve `random-mm` and `random-rerank` in `vllm bench throughput` when no dataset path is supplied. Previously, argument validation replaced either selection with `random`, so the documented multimodal command sampled text-only requests.

## Claims

- Keep the requested synthetic dataset through validation; retain the existing default random-text fallback and `prefix_repetition` behavior.
- Verify that throughput's parser, validation, and shared sampler produce image-bearing chat requests without `--dataset-path`, while retaining the existing `mm-processor` regression coverage.

## Validation

Run from the checkout with a uv-managed Python 3.12 environment. Local validation used WSL and an existing CPU installation, with this checkout first on `PYTHONPATH`.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py -q -k without_dataset_path
```

Before the production fix: **2 failed, 3 passed**. The failures were `random-rerank` being renamed and throughput's `random-mm` producing text-only prompts.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py --deselect tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py::test_bench_throughput -q --disable-warnings
pre-commit run --files vllm/benchmarks/throughput.py tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py docs/benchmarking/cli.md
pre-commit run mypy-3.12 --hook-stage manual --files vllm/benchmarks/throughput.py tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py
git diff --check
```

After the fix: **13 passed, 2 deselected**; all applicable pre-commit hooks, Python 3.12 mypy, and whitespace checks passed. Pytest's deselection prefix excludes the model-running `test_bench_throughput` and `test_bench_throughput_accepts_custom_audio_args`. No GPU benchmark or model accuracy evaluation was run; this change is limited to benchmark workload selection. Existing Benchmarks CLI CI runs the entire `tests/benchmarks/` directory on NVIDIA and AMD.

## Details

The no-path fallback exempted only `prefix_repetition`. Add the other two pathless synthetic datasets to that exemption, leaving the existing `random` validation path intact. Clarify the documented `random-mm` invocation.

Duplicate-work checks found no open PR for this fix. Searches covered `"random-mm" "throughput.py"`, `"throughput" "dataset" in:title`, `"random-rerank"`, and related validation/fallback terms. Reviewed nearby work: #41541 adds benchmark metadata, #55937 changes Rust timed-trace support, and closed #36035 addresses length-argument defaults rather than dataset selection.

AI assistance was used: Codex helped investigate the bug, implement the change, write tests, run validation, and prepare this description.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@ywang96 @DarkLight1337 could you take a look when you have a chance? This fixes vllm bench throughput silently replacing random-mm and random-rerank with random when no dataset path is supplied. The PR has been rebased, and regression tests and local validation results are included in the description. Thanks!

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
I prefer having separate test cases so we don't end up with branching logic

🔴 Running `vllm bench throughput --dataset-name random-rerank --no-reranker` without --dataset-path (and without an explicit --random-batch-size) now reaches RandomDatasetForReranking.sample instead of being silently rewritten to the random dataset, and crashes with a raw, unhandled AssertionError (pre-existing bug) because --random-batch-size defaults to 1 while `assert num_requests > 1 and batchsize > 1` at vllm/benchmarks/datasets/datasets.py:814 requires batchsize > 1 whenever --no-reranker is set. Fix: validate_args should raise a clear ValueError when --no-reranker is combined with --random-batch-size <= 1, covering both the with- and without---dataset-path cases, instead of letting the assert fire deep inside the sampler.

<details>
<summary>Why this was flagged</summary>

Trigger: `vllm bench throughput --dataset-name random-rerank --no-reranker` with no --dataset-path and no --random-batch-size, entering validate_args (vllm/benchmarks/throughput.py:642-646, now exempting random-rerank) then get_requests -> get_samples -> RandomDatasetForReranking.sample. --random-batch-size defaults to 1 (datasets.py:1922) and is_reranker=not args.no_reranker is False, so `assert num_requests > 1 and batchsize > 1` at datasets.py:813-814 fails. Before this diff, this combination was silently rewritten to dataset_name='random', never reaching that code; now it crashes with an unhandled AssertionError and no actionable message. The assert is already reachable with --dataset-path set, so it is pre-existing, but no validate_args check guards the --no-reranker/--random-batch-size interaction for either case.

**Verification:** pre-existing. The scenario is reachable: throughput.py:642-646 exempts random-rerank from the no-path rewrite, so running without --dataset-path or --random-batch-size flows into RandomDatasetForReranking.sample with batchsize=1. At datasets.py:813-814, `assert num_requests > 1 and batchsize > 1` fails, raising a raw AssertionError. validate_args has no guard requiring batchsize>1 for --no-reranker; throughput.py:681-698 only emits "ignored" warnings.

</details>

<!-- bhfn:1:normal -->

files.patch:
@@ -887,7 +887,7 @@ vllm bench throughput \
 
 #### Synthetic Random Multimodal (random-mm)
 
-Generate synthetic multimodal inputs for offline throughput testing without external datasets.
+Use `--dataset-name random-mm` without `--dataset-path` to generate synthetic multimodal inputs for offline throughput testing.
 Use `--backend vllm-chat` so that image tokens are counted correctly.
 
 ```bash

@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
     add_cli_args,
     assign_loras,
     get_requests,
+    validate_args,
 )
 from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
 
@@ -74,6 +75,19 @@ def test_bench_throughput_accepts_custom_audio_args():
     assert args.enable_multimodal_chat
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dataset_name", [None, "random-rerank", "prefix_repetition"])
+def test_validate_args_without_dataset_path(dataset_name: str | None):
+    parser = FlexibleArgumentParser()
+    add_cli_args(parser)
+    args = parser.parse_args(
+        [] if dataset_name is None else ["--dataset-name", dataset_name]
+    )
+
+    validate_args(args)
+
+    assert args.dataset_name == (dataset_name or "random")
+
+
 def test_vllm_chat_requests_include_multimodal_content():
     class FakeLLM:
         def __init__(self):
@@ -323,22 +337,24 @@ def test_to_serve_args_keeps_legacy_flag_fallback() -> None:
 
 
 @pytest.mark.benchmark
-def test_get_requests_random_mm_with_mm_processor_args(
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("benchmark", ["throughput", "mm-processor"])
+def test_get_requests_random_mm_without_dataset_path(
+    benchmark: str,
     hf_tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase,
 ) -> None:
-    """Regression: bench mm-processor's random-mm sampling must not crash.
-
-    get_requests feeds mm-processor's parsed args (no legacy length/backend
-    flags) through the shared get_samples dispatch. With the default
-    --random-prefix-len 0 this previously crashed inside
-    RandomMultiModalDataset.get_prefix with a TypeError.
-    """
+    """Both CLI paths must retain synthetic images without a dataset path."""
     from vllm.benchmarks.mm_processor import add_cli_args as add_mm_cli_args
 
     parser = FlexibleArgumentParser()
-    add_mm_cli_args(parser)
+    if benchmark == "throughput":
+        add_cli_args(parser)
+        backend_args = ["--backend", "vllm-chat"]
+    else:
+        add_mm_cli_args(parser)
+        backend_args = []
     args = parser.parse_args(
         [
+            *backend_args,
             "--dataset-name",
             "random-mm",
             "--num-prompts",
@@ -357,12 +373,12 @@ def test_get_requests_random_mm_with_mm_processor_args(
             "{(224, 224, 1): 1.0}",
         ]
     )
+    if benchmark == "throughput":
+        validate_args(args)
 
     requests = get_requests(args, hf_tokenizer)
     assert len(requests) == 3
     assert all(isinstance(r, SampleRequest) for r in requests)
-    # mm-processor drives llm.chat, so prompts must be chat-formatted with
-    # multimodal content attached.
     for req in requests:
         assert isinstance(req.prompt, list)
         assert req.prompt[0]["role"] == "user"

@@ -639,7 +639,11 @@ def validate_args(args):
         raise ValueError("--prequeue-requests is not supported with --async-engine")
 
     # === Dataset Configuration ===
-    if not args.dataset_path and args.dataset_name != "prefix_repetition":
+    if not args.dataset_path and args.dataset_name not in {
+        "random-mm",
+        "random-rerank",
+        "prefix_repetition",
+    }:
         print("When dataset path is not set, it will default to random dataset")
         args.dataset_name = "random"
         random_input_len = getattr(args, "random_input_len", None)
